advisors.name: anon_security_definer_function_executable
advisors.title: Public Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
advisors.remediation: https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/database-linter?lint=0028_anon_security_definer_function_executable

findings.detail: Function `public.check_report_threshold()` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/check_report_threshold`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.handle_new_user()` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/handle_new_user`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.update_politician_verification_tier()` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/update_politician_verification_tier`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
